You just need to care about whether Tim Moore keeps fighting for you in Congress. [](https://timmoore.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fwftl-hkhielhuy-r/) **Friday, July 31st | 5:00 PM | Gaston Country Club, 3700 County Club Drive, Gastonia, NC** I'll be there. Tim will be there. The only thing missing is you. This event is part of that. Friend, July 31st is coming in just a few days, and with it our end-of-month fundraising deadline. _Before we ask you to chip in, can we take a minute to explain why this deadline matters so much?_ This deadline is about more than just a number. What we raise before August will help determine how strong our campaign is heading into November, and how much we can invest in organizing, reaching voters, supporting Democrats up and down the ballot, and responding to Republican attacks. Martin is taking on some of the biggest fights facing New Mexicans and our country. He voted against a defense bill that would give the Trump administration a blank check for a reckless war with Iran. He’s fighting attempts to sell off treasured public lands like the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge for oil and gas drilling. And he’s standing up to the decisions driving up grocery, housing, health care, and energy costs for working families. **But Martin cannot take on these fights alone.** Republicans and their wealthy allies are already pouring money into races across the country. | | | Dear Friend, **Across Alaska, elections are conducted, public records maintained, and local governments kept running by dedicated local government clerks. Yet many communities are struggling to fill these essential positions**. We're writing today with an exciting update: Build Alaska's Future has launched the first of three new short-form videos for our [Clerks initiative](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136252647/636837356/-656634486?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZGNkMDNlNC1hOThiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=A5A6gjE0ZJNlyjev2IJvhCpYr-PU1ib94m8rhNfkFmo=&emci=ad860abd-9d86-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=adcd03e4-a98b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=9512399), and we'd love your help spreading the word. [**'Good Work, Close to Home'**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136252649/636837358/1504491898?si=tsqJ0FZULZcZ0qef&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZGNkMDNlNC1hOThiLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=A5A6gjE0ZJNlyjev2IJvhCpYr-PU1ib94m8rhNfkFmo=&emci=ad860abd-9d86-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=adcd03e4-a98b-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=9512399) **This first video is a call to action for Alaskans looking for stable, meaningful work close to home**. It features Donald Jones of Kotzebue, Beth McEwen of Juneau, and Gina Gregg of Fairbanks, who share their own experiences as clerks and why the work matters. **Local government clerks are the backbone of civic life:** they run elections, maintain public records, and keep town, city, and tribal offices functioning. name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Can’t stop thinking about this…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
Hi Peter,
I know it's late, but my mind is swirling thinking about these AIPAC ads.
AIPAC-aligned super PACs have now dumped $59+ million into Michigan to prop up their preferred candidate. It’s hard to even picture what that much money could do.
**But despite that unfathomable amount of cash, I still think we’re going to win next Tuesday.** Here’s why:
AIPAC has done this before, in primary races just like ours. It's spent millions trying to bury campaigns that wouldn't play by its rules — and in almost every one of those races, one of two scenarios plays out:
1. When a campaign has the resources to tell its own story and break through the noise, AIPAC's ads don't land.
2. When a campaign runs dry, gets overwhelmed, and can't respond, that's when AIPAC's ads seal their fate.

So the honest answer to whether we get through this isn't complicated. It comes down to whether we have enough grassroots power to keep running our own ads, reaching our own voters, and maintain control of our story before AIPAC defines it for us.

subject: Less than 100 days to go
body:
With less than 100 days left, it is time to go all in.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**We’re LESS THAN 100 days away from Election Day. To mark 100 days out we activated hundreds of volunteers**** _in over 50 countie_****s this weekend alone.**
We just want to say _thank you_ to everyone who came out, and we’d like to take a moment to tell you how everyone fighting to get Gina Hinojosa elected to be the next Governor of Texas spent this past weekend. This matters because...
Before the election is called...
Before ballots are cast...

What can we take away from all this court news? That opponents of voting rights aren't going to stop attacking vote-by-mail. They're not deterred by losing one Supreme Court case, and they'll appeal every other decision all the way there as well, if they need to. The legal costs don't matter to them, since the voter suppression movement is well-funded by a few billionaires.
Our grassroots movement is fighting back, but our work is only possible with your help. Pitch in $35 or more right now to defend vote-by-mail and make every vote count in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=072826_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: Appeals court backs Trump bid to block some mail ballots, for now, as Supreme Court mulls issue [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=072826_2&amount=35]
Bad news today, Team.
A federal appeals court ruled today that the Trump administration may continue implementing President Donald Trump’s anti-mail voting executive order . The U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia affirmed a lower court’s decision, holding that a lawsuit challenging the constitutionality of Trump’s March 2026 edict was premature because the administration hasn’t executed it yet.
This is a different case from the U.S. Supreme Court's recent ruling on counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day . That case, Watson V. RNC , ended with rational minds choosing to count ballots that were mailed on time.
This case is different: Trump's Executive Order from March 2026 ordered the U.S. Postal Service (USPS) to send mail ballots in new barcoded envelopes only to voters on citizenship lists compiled by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and the Social Security Administration. After defenders of voting rights quickly sued, a U.S. District Court Judge denied the preliminary injunction back in May, saying it would be premature to issue it when the federal agencies hadn’t begun implementation yet. The appeal of that ruling is what was decided today.
It's worth noting that both courts said the case was "premature," which means that no voter had yet been harmed by the order, so the court was unable to rule on the merits of the case. This means that neither court made any decision on the merits of the case brought to protect mail-in ballots.
Listen, we know this is a lot of information, Team. The long and short of it is that we need your help to keep standing up to this Executive Order and protect mail-in voting. The Executive Order to have USPS work with DHS and Social Security to subvert the Constitution purports to address “non-citizen voting.” States, however, already have proven systems in place to verify voter eligibility, non-citizen voting is already a federal crime, and instances are vanishingly rare.
Of course, this ruling came just a day after the DOJ asked the U.S. Supreme Court to lift a block on implementing the order in 23 Democratic-led states and Washington, D.C. upheld just a few days ago, in a separate case ( California V. Trump ).
It's simple: These Trump executive orders are dangerous, unlawful, and harmful to voters. We will never stay silent when the right to vote is attacked, Team, including by a hostile administration in control of the federal government.

clean_body: And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. | | | | Dear Friend, Will you help me put God back in your town schools? | | | They are wonderfully made in the very image of God. And that God is calling them to love Him above all else. What a country we'd be, if all of America's children had just a little bit of God's Word in their lives - like you did. Our Founding Fathers understood this. That's why throughout our history, the Bible has been the cornerstone of American life, education, and law. Abraham Lincoln believed the Bible was "the best gift God has given to man." And Dwight D. Eisenhower said, "Without God there could be no American form of government, nor an American way of life." But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. Justice Stewart Potter was the lone dissenter in the Supreme Court decision that outlawed the mandatory reading of the Bible in schools. He wrote that the ruling didn't 'protect religious freedom' but rather 'established a religion of secularism.' And how right he was! But even Justice Potter wouldn't have predicted how far the 'religion of secularism' has taken us from Biblical values. ...today radical "educators" teach our children and grandchildren that: God is a myth for the weak and if their families believe in Him, they're probably uneducated, hateful, and racist. If these "educators" do acknowledge God, they say He makes mistakes and some boys are really girls and some girls are really boys. And they wrongly tell children, 'God just wants you to be happy' so you should do whatever you want, do whatever feels good, and anyone who tells you otherwise is an old- fashioned bigot who has to go. So many families are being torn apart by this madness that overturns everything our Founders believed. It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools. Your signature on your "Schools Need a Bible Revival" petition tells our elected officials that you want biblical lessons put back in our public schools. Think public schools are too far gone? Think I'm dreaming? Consider this... BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group behind my "See You at the Library" movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left's "Drag Queen Story Hours." BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year! And BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish - and that America was founded upon - back into public schools this year! HOW? We've designed a mini-curriculum for America's 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation's Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. With you and BRAVE FOR GOOD behind me, I know we can expand that number to 250,000 children this year in honor of America's 250th Anniversary. You know it won't be easy. The radical leftists who've taken over our public schools aren't just going to put out the welcome mat. That's why BRAVE FOR GOOD is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. The 1963 ruling 100% allows for the Bible to be taught in a historical or cultural context! And why wouldn't it be? In every corner of the world, the Bible is considered one of the greatest books ever written. Of course children should learn about it in your taxpayer-funded schools! But radical educators will try to keep anything to do with the Bible out of our schools and when they do, BRAVE FOR GOOD will be ready to counter them with thousands of signed petitions. And will you please also consider a tax-deductible petition sponsorship gift of $35 or more? Every petition you send digitally must still be delivered, verified, securely collected, and tabulated before it can be presented -- That means your gift today puts hundreds of new voices on the record before the deadline. To be blunt, BRAVE FOR GOOD is a small but mighty Christian non-profit and this Bible Revival is funded entirely as a grassroots effort from patriots like you. It won't be easy going up against taxpayer-funded public schools and their unlimited money. But I know we can do it. Together with BRAVE FOR GOOD and patriots like you , we got conservative and patriotic values back into public libraries. Only God can lead our nation back to His Word. Thank you for standing with us. Sincerely, | | | Kirk Cameron BRAVE For Good | | | | ** Our best chance to put the biblical values our nation was founded upon back into schools is this year during America's 250th Anniversary so please hurry. | | | BRAVE FOR GOOD is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. * 61% ages 30–44.
* 46% of men.
* 46% of women.
* And more than 40% in every region of Wisconsin.

We talk a lot about the broad, diverse coalition we’re building, and it's showing up in the Marquette poll.

body:
| |

Hi Peter,

Campaigns generate a lot of noise. I want to tell you what I have actually delivered.

I wrote SB 35, which has **accelerated thousands of homes across California, including over 4,000 affordable homes in San Francisco.**

I wrote SB 79, which **made it legal to build more housing near major public transit**. People said it could not pass. We built a coalition, took on entrenched opposition, and got it signed into law.

When **BART and Muni faced financial collapse, I helped secure $1.1 billion in emergency state funding and another $500 million loan**. Then I passed legislation allowing the Bay Area to **create a permanent source of transit funding**.

I wrote the law **capping insulin at $35 a month** and it took effect this January.

I wrote the nation's **first law requiring billion-dollar corporations to disclose their carbon emissions**. The oil and gas lobby fought it for years. California is implementing it right now, while the Trump administration dismantles federal climate rules.

I wrote the **nation’s first law prohibiting ICE and other law enforcement officers from hiding behind masks**. When Trump’s Department of Homeland Security demanded a veto, we stood firm and got it signed.

I wrote the **No Kings Act to give people a path to justice when federal agents violate their constitutional rights**. It passed the California Senate 30 to 10.

I also wrote **California’s transgender refuge law, which protects families fleeing states that criminalize gender-affirming care** and inspired similar protections across the country.

That is the kind of leadership I will bring to Congress.

Identify a hard problem. Build a coalition. Take the heat. Get something done.

We close the books on July tomorrow night. clean_body: | | Hi Peter, Campaigns generate a lot of noise. I want to tell you what I have actually delivered. I wrote SB 35, which has accelerated thousands of homes across California, including over 4,000 affordable homes in San Francisco. I wrote SB 79, which made it legal to build more housing near major public transit. People said it could not pass. We built a coalition, took on entrenched opposition, and got it signed into law. When BART and Muni faced financial collapse, I helped secure $1.1 billion in emergency state funding and another $500 million loan. Then I passed legislation allowing the Bay Area to create a permanent source of transit funding. I wrote the law capping insulin at $35 a month and it took effect this January. I wrote the nation's first law requiring billion-dollar corporations to disclose their carbon emissions. The oil and gas lobby fought it for years. California is implementing it right now, while the Trump administration dismantles federal climate rules. I wrote the nation’s first law prohibiting ICE and other law enforcement officers from hiding behind masks. When Trump’s Department of Homeland Security demanded a veto, we stood firm and got it signed. I wrote the No Kings Act to give people a path to justice when federal agents violate their constitutional rights. It passed the California Senate 30 to 10. I also wrote California’s transgender refuge law, which protects families fleeing states that criminalize gender-affirming care and inspired similar protections across the country. That is the kind of leadership I will bring to Congress. Identify a hard problem. Build a coalition. Take the heat. Get something done. GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE

Friend,

No one could hear her.

A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic.

No windows. No fresh air. No way out.

The door was locked from the outside.

For months she lived there.
Alone.

There was no bathroom.
Just a bucket.

No shower. No clean clothes.

And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex.
Over. And over. And over.

This is the reality of child trafficking.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-vb0E1Vmbcsvim4NwNGBhBhBv9wOZ1QOAzDeOib3cMhWhKV69jSPEnWrdS7KJYCupu2Zj7WO0B5IA17Wmf8zdedw1TC6W7Cx7vC2Q

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-vcss8l7MIz0KwsVbThe64ZmiYDPqxyvqNpQtautKnIoM2yoeXkmw3jE6djooqvvq2g0yz6SI0ON5dHLfcH2SosRoK1Jq9cdqcLhA
Send help to children waiting

Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world.

But Kristen’s story did not end in that attic.

One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another “date.”

But instead…she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers.

When Kristen realized she was safe…

She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates.

Free.

Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal.

She took the first step toward healing.

This rescue was possible because people chose to act.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-vdbSwskLblP7KgNkpIhEk0Xbcnc_0KhXZLTbRc3P13Mc0nltaTFGPpiS7SEqZESOgYh-JzoKQ01XamGXY3YeP6YFQJQPgrFBEzQQ
Send help to children waiting

The Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God’s children.

Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom, the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children.

Our mission is simple.

To stop the sale of God’s children.

And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix.

Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight.

Then on day three…they go into the field.

Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-veJJotQNR47FmW_I9Byr2rG_z4du3iKEXswZtr6mYMrAZrXUOJwW4oE5EsxbG1s6K9fMnCdkK7hhSiPlk5F9icOIM7P2SgUrPzHQ

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-vfKC2tDvrhru0_JhUPe-7s_zak9Lp_IyjmoovnJFtewU4wm0WOiVNYfEn29YUY0zhvQUdCzPXE7uKHsNvpkMVpu7JPb_5fqd89NQ

Children like Kristen are waiting.

But these missions cannot happen without support from people who care.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-vgNkqacD7RtgW0MRYTh86_qkAKB9dLTCQuJs9E5xSJ9S783rR-ryRSMaD846SZcd9HUw_vVymO41f4NOtcslDr0Yyq0FDpBpgFdQ
Send help to children waiting

That is why I am reaching out to you today.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-vhZxmFqoGt7nF0ufcISPuxFMV2fAgZDyAb2TLpWGGk-GJ_ho3KYnHPEWGXQipezAsEzfxyA--4HSB2GcCIEJLN2TCtkvcRNjz8zg

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-vi5wX03LakrKFjyQ-WzJaqvqy5A2S8v6AiGtdHWj_Cnl9gS26Ck8dtPDM9nlhSIgaRLGO-UI-SstNRxwaz7cakzmSfquApybwm-A

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-vjVfNTEkSksyklgIiN-2LbER4xKkrk4DXPvLeShhNnGXABLn_6D-GsBM98AhyLpsc-VcTH9TJPxoeT8Req32NTKvgx5qpD-KlX2A
Would you consider making your first gift of $30, $60, $130 or whatever you can do right now to help rescue children from trafficking?

Your donation today can help:

- Train officers to find trafficked children
- Support rescue operations
- Provide food, clothing, and care for survivors
- Help children begin the journey to healing

When I first heard the stories of trafficked children, I asked myself a question.

What if it were my child?

I could not stay silent.
And you do not have to either.

Friend, will you please help rescue the next child today?

Your gift — whatever God places on your heart — will help bring freedom to children still waiting in the dark.

Together we can make sure more children hear the Sound of Freedom.

With gratitude and prayer,

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NTN9AAwAAAAAAgm54-vkDYAfmJU4ZGBgwYabLF5dUSY49HMLDfbGaYrnqWwFA46MlhQpP4WaOFDfCjOcWmuaDdE2ev_FYLlKP0CQXAT54sBUVBByYEU3Gg

Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation

Please pray about what you can do to help and donate today.

Just days ago, independent journalist Nick Shirley walked into the California State Capitol with a camera and confronted the Democrat lawmakers who are trying to silence him.

Because California Democrats are fast-tracking AB 2624 — already being called the “Stop Nick Shirley Act.”

And the ultimate irony? The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they’re trying to criminalize investigative journalism.

They had no good answer.

A formerly illicit Chinese cannabis grow was the site of an armed robbery on Wednesday, but the Kennebec Sheriff's Office is releasing few details on who robbed the pot growers and whether the burglary was related to the Asian Transnational Criminal Organizations that have infested Maine with clandestine cannabis cultivation sites.
A source who asked not to be named identified the property as 211 Bartlett Road in Belgrade, one of at least nine locations in Belgrade that federal or state law enforcement suspects of operating as an illicit marijuana grow.
The last time Chinese organized crime saw a law enforcement action in Belgrade was in [January 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/d2c0a25c-1468-446d-98a3-f824159ccaed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), when two related drug operations on Point Road and Guptill Road were taken down on the same day. Those operations led to the arrest of 66-year-old Lin Min Chan of Florida and 44-year-old Yuequan Chen, as well as the confiscation of 2,300 live marijuana plants. The Guptill Road property was owned by Ying Ci Mei, 50, of Brooklyn, N.Y., while the Point Road property was owned by Siu Yin Huang, 65, of Uncasville, Conn.
Sheriff's deputies said three men entered a residential building in Belgrade, tied up two individuals, and then stole all the marijuana and an undisclosed amount of money. One of the suspects pointed a gun at the victims while they were being tied up, WGME reported. The Kennebec Sheriff's Office did not release any information about the couple living at the home at the time of the burglary or the potential suspects.
According to real estate records, tax records, corporate records, and electrical records, the property is controlled by Yiqiang Huang, a Mandarin-speaking cannabis entrepreneur who is well known to regulators at the Office of Cannabis Policy.
Huang purchased the property in Sept. 2023. Like more than 75 other Chinese cannabis growers, he financed the property using a loan from [Quontic Bank](https://substack.com/redirect/f4f2a17e-c9e4-43ca-a3af-ca07feda4c01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a bank in New York that has made a fortune offering special loans to foreign nationals and non-citizens -- loans that are de-risked by the taxpayer-funded Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) designation.
RELATED:
* [Treasury Drops Hammer on ex-Quontic Bank Mortgager Linked to Maine's Chinese Cannabis Houses](https://substack.com/redirect/7e0ffed8-b399-4b3a-8251-d143f1e89016?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* [Triad Weed: One NYC Bank Financed More Than 50 Illicit Chinese Marijuana Grow Houses in Rural Maine](https://substack.com/redirect/4bccc3c3-0680-447b-adfd-0b3439944eca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* [How the U.S. Treasury Department Helps Chinese Organized Crime Transform American Homes Into Drug Dens](https://substack.com/redirect/f4f2a17e-c9e4-43ca-a3af-ca07feda4c01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Immediately after closing on the property, Huang installed 400-amp commercial grade electricity -- a physical prerequisite for converting a middle-class Maine home into a dingy marijuana dump. The electrical permit record explicitly states that the increased power was for a cannabis cultivation operation.
Huang began cultivating cannabis illegally right away, according to OCP records obtained by _The Robinson Report_ under a Freedom of Access Act request. Only later, in March 2024, did he attempt to apply for a medicinal cannabis registration from the state. But, as part of that process, the state caught Huang running an unlicensed grow, denied his caregiver application, and even said in writing that he'd falsified his paperwork.

The state never filed charges against him for falsifying his paperwork.
Instead, eighteen months later, his registration is active -- same number, same town -- courtesy of OCP Director John Hudak's belief that even known affiliates of the Chinese mafia have a right to partake in what is quickly become Maine's number one industry.
**[[RELATED: Maine Pot Czar Admits State Is Licensing Foreign Criminal Orgs to Grow Cannabis, Says Hands Tied...]](https://substack.com/redirect/c03dcac0-ee4f-4776-a088-11e14b146942?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The last time Chinese organized crime saw a law enforcement action in Belgrade was in [January 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/d2c0a25c-1468-446d-98a3-f824159ccaed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), when two related drug operations on Point Road and Guptill Road were taken down on the same day. Those operations led to the arrest of 66-year-old Lin Min Chan of Florida and 44-year-old Yuequan Chen, as well as the confiscation of 2,300 live marijuana plants. The Guptill Road property was owned by Ying Ci Mei, 50, of Brooklyn, N.Y., while the Point Road property was owned by Siu Yin Huang, 65, of Uncasville, Conn.
In the case of the Guptill Road and Point Road grows, the state police knew about the operations and knew for a fact that they were illegal drug sites for several months before troopers finally pulled the plug on the Chinese facilities. According to [court records ](https://substack.com/redirect/aafca8a2-7694-4980-81e6-30fe2e849ba8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)obtained by _The Maine Wire_ , the Maine State Police knew that the Belgrade sites were operating in brazen disregard for Maine's cannabis laws for nearly six months before they reluctantly executed an enforcement action.
The state police's bizarre and inexplicable delay in taking action against the two Chinese marijuana sites -- both located just ten miles from the Maine State Police headquarters -- only underscored how Maine's top statewide law enforcement body has been AWOL in the effort to combat Chinese organized crime.
**[[RELATED: Maine Gov. Janet Mills' Brother Helped Transfer Nine-Acre Black Market Cannabis Grow to Chinese National "Mother" Living in Guangdong Province: Triad Weed...]](https://substack.com/redirect/1cdc4d02-3fb9-4771-85e0-ef11a9b29055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Indeed, those two Belgrade raids, which came only after Maine's Chinese cannabis epidemic began receiving national attention, are two of fewer than five raids that have involved the Maine State Police or the Maine Drug Enforcement Agency. Instead, Maine's county sheriffs have had to handle almost all of the investigative and enforcement work against the transnational criminal organizations.
**[[RELATED: Governor Silent as Chinese Cannabis Cartels Swallow Rural Maine-- Some With Her Brother's Help...]](https://substack.com/redirect/6dd4937a-3239-490e-a2b0-20412be402c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
To this day, neither [Gov. Janet Mills (D)](https://substack.com/redirect/1cdc4d02-3fb9-4771-85e0-ef11a9b29055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), whose brother has worked as a real estate attorney for illicit Chinese cannabis traffickers, nor her commissioner of the Department of Public Safety, Michael J. Sauschuck, has [commented](https://substack.com/redirect/6dd4937a-3239-490e-a2b0-20412be402c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the scourge of Chinese organized crime that has consumed well more than 270 residential and commercial properties throughout rural Maine.
This isn't the first time Chinese cannabis goombas have found themselves suddenly deprived of a mysteriously large stash of cash.
In Sept. 2024, _The Maine Wire_ reported on an uncovered [spree of stealth burglaries](https://substack.com/redirect/c5d4d8fc-87a3-4c41-85d3-92e86189f7fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that seemed to be targeting owners of Asian restaurants who just so happened to have tangential connections to other agricultural endeavors.
In those cases, law enforcement suspects other criminal operators are to blame, i.e. triad on triad crime, and no arrests have been made.

#### OCP Licenses a Chinese Scofflaw
That OCP told WGME the Bartlett Road location was a licensed cultivation site is all the more mysterious considering how Yiqiang Huang's second attempt at getting a medicinal marijuana license went down.
[[RELATED: Illegal Chinese Neurotoxins Are Coming to Maine's Blackmarket Cannabis Grows: Maine Threat Brief...]](https://substack.com/redirect/45827669-de45-41d3-aa9f-d4ea23feecff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
On May 29, 2024, OCP Field Investigator Matthew Clark was assigned to conduct the pre-license inspection. The denial letter that followed is blunt about what the agency already knew:
> "The address of [REDACTED] was previously familiar to OCP and law enforcement, as the suspected site of an illegal/unlicensed cultivation location."
On May 31, Clark and Field Investigator Christopher Carr drove out. Huang answered the door and talked to them through a crack in it. His identity was confirmed by the Massachusetts driver's license he handed over.

A source who asked not to be named identified the property as 211 Bartlett Road in Belgrade, one of at least nine locations in Belgrade that federal or state law enforcement suspects of operating as an illicit marijuana grow. The last time Chinese organized crime saw a law enforcement action in Belgrade was in , when two related drug operations on Point Road and Guptill Road were taken down on the same day. Those operations led to the arrest of 66-year-old Lin Min Chan of Florida and 44-year-old Yuequan Chen, as well as the confiscation of 2,300 live marijuana plants. The Guptill Road property was owned by Ying Ci Mei, 50, of Brooklyn, N.Y., while the Point Road property was owned by Siu Yin Huang, 65, of Uncasville, Conn. Sheriff's deputies said three men entered a residential building in Belgrade, tied up two individuals, and then stole all the marijuana and an undisclosed amount of money. One of the suspects pointed a gun at the victims while they were being tied up, WGME reported. The Kennebec Sheriff's Office did not release any information about the couple living at the home at the time of the burglary or the potential suspects. According to real estate records, tax records, corporate records, and electrical records, the property is controlled by Yiqiang Huang, a Mandarin-speaking cannabis entrepreneur who is well known to regulators at the Office of Cannabis Policy. Huang purchased the property in Sept. 2023. Like more than 75 other Chinese cannabis growers, he financed the property using a loan from , a bank in New York that has made a fortune offering special loans to foreign nationals and non-citizens -- loans that are de-risked by the taxpayer-funded Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) designation. ## New Six Flags Coaster to Break 6 World Records
Six Flags Great Adventure unveiled [a record-breaking new roller coaster](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQRp8GOqPB_GULF9vQZdstkbHHZDbGjmacEPbpr3Jf4VZf8-no6Py9LldLkdL2x-5oSshLwkMiloK8SGG6o-REbBOjPHcM9unosWjQo4JJdbB4S_Fc-tqbgKixq9G002XoYew6Xd9MO7gJB-gvbnLgfQshaLfiuIJ2g7a-JvOhwdRBC61uoVm7dXArDH1rL7-cH6oe0FPJ3PzLlMoNQzzzC7lxea-juZXykKr7Xem50vNxHE3I7_UplFDk86n0HCmglDNipWehtwrRbqI4x4isXLZSkNXKaO9qVEfm6BWjy-xFFWSmcFLalN3t_88yeazZ-MdBMZKMU9XDtluK30blRxlfRn8FAAD__zqbi1w) Tuesday that will send riders 382 feet into the sky at 100 mph. Bakunawa, named for a moon-devouring sea serpent from Philippine mythology, opens at the New Jersey park in 2027. The ride will claim [six world records](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAQBOCnMV3Qeo0DFC7-hi5_eyVamyXxxeDINrHy9ifuFa6bYvSNNF-3-UY--P3-nzY2ZY3zzjUHLoXTnEvyT85x94n2xPnYeKXD-deMgNcL9BcF80I-fOauWczKjKwaNrIfdAdXpbB5GKcJOqVHiQjW6tUCL6NjNUg5MvWy8ebUoFcgQaKE1iqrnQXdSRpGt2jRAS--xNR-R7-XB6_hE9-cWhe3JphHKa8s1D-Bk8Cp1tq6SLlwkiDPisDpHBA4QX_mQeBk6XnsVEng1CSzvKoPwedrLzq4b-TDL13-9Mfb4E8AAAD__8y9cb8), including the world's first upside-down launch. Riders will accelerate from 60 to 80 mph while fully inverted. Free-spinning, floorless trains rotate independently throughout the 3,163-foot course, [so no two rides are identical](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OozAQAJ8GOkfG5i-Fi2vocu2VaLHXsBdjI3sJl3v6T_le4etHo9H8ecwPoEBx_Q07GvZpjniVgMyY58KZnlhSpAwxYzl39HBaOmYlVS_kILScHVB4z23tjEdUqGs0zTB2rey1VvVm7GjHewsd2gXt3Tu9tI1CaYcOOtl7X5P52OSgZSMb1cjbopfOLrJrGxjv1nVVK9ERp3z7myjyhj680wvzzaa9DmZjPkqlf1VqqtQEzBksU4plhxX-U8QPV6mp0D_hA6xFrBmBBbgXRj4zigWeZ4QLhE1QGLM4j0IOhUtXFAHOaLdKTXU27rgoBCr9ULVy3YHCdwP_aNzLqK8AAAD__x6thls). Each trip lasts about two minutes and 17 seconds. Bakunawa rises near the former site of Kingda Ka, the beloved 456-foot giant demolished last year after two decades as an icon of the park. **Dear _Flyover_ Reader,** A month ago, the _Minnesota Star Tribune_ won a Pulitzer Prize. Last week, it announced it's cutting 15% of its staff.

That's been the shape of the whole year. In February, the _Washington Post_ eliminated more than 300 newsroom jobs and closed its sports and books desks outright. The BBC is shedding up to 2,000 roles. BuzzFeed and HuffPost cut about a third of their people. In Pittsburgh, the _Post-Gazette_ shuttered its entire opinion section and published its last editorial.

Here's what none of those outlets will say out loud: this is what happens when you spend years telling your audience what to think instead of what happened. Readers can tell when the news is tilted, and they've been walking away by the millions.

The numbers back it up. Gallup now finds just 28% of Americans trust the media to report the news fully, accurately, and fairly. That's the lowest it has ever measured.

The legacy media created this problem. _The Flyover_ was built to be the solution, and the difference is simple. They editorialize in their reporting. We don't. They tell you what to think about the news; we just show you what happened, clearly and fairly, and trust you to make up your own mind.

And it's working: while they shrink, we're about to cross six million readers. Six million Americans who start their morning with the facts and decide for themselves. They're fleeing the spin, and they're finding us.

_The Flyover_ will always be free. Producing it isn't.

So as we close in on six million, let me ask you two questions:

Do you rely on us for news without the spin? Is fact-first journalism worth fighting for?

If your answer is yes, will you chip in and help us hit this milestone at full speed?

I'll be honest with you: I read the same headlines you do, and there are mornings this industry looks like it's coming apart. But then I look at what this team builds every single day, and at six million of you choosing the facts over the spin, and I've never been more sure we're on the right side.

Will you support _The Flyover_ today? I'd appreciate it very much. body:
Good Afternoon Team Saritha!
Thank you for signing up to support Saritha Komatireddy and our campaign to defeat Letitia James and restore Law and Order to New York State. There’s less than one hundred days until the general election, and we’re grateful to have you on the team as we work together to WIN this November.
We’ve hit the ground running, and your support is exactly what Saritha needs to keep building massive momentum right now. Here are three quick ways you can jump in and make an impact this week:
1\. Share Saritha’s Social Media Content
Please help us spread the word by sharing our latest posts with your friends, family, and networks. You can find content to share here:
[www.facebook.com/sarithaforny](http://www.facebook.com/sarithaforny)

[x.com/sarithaforny](http://x.com/sarithaforny)

Saritha wants to be where the people are, listening to the concerns of every New Yorker. If there’s a festival, town hall, or neighborhood gathering happening near you, let us know so Saritha can be there:
[forms.gle/mZSi5osex8nU5D5X8](https://forms.gle/mZSi5osex8nU5D5X8)

Our movement grows stronger when our supporters bring their friends and family into the fold. Please reach out to your personal network and encourage them to join our team by signing up to volunteer.

Every post you share, every event you flag, and every hour you volunteer brings us one step closer to victory. We are so grateful to have you in this fight with us.
Onward,
Team Saritha

body:
This fight is heavy, and Jesus Christ is my inspiration.

This fight is heavy, and Jesus Christ is my inspiration.
| Friend,
[Jesus Christ carried the cross to Calvary and fell under its weight three times. He stumbled. He rose. He kept walking, because what waited on that hill was salvation for his children.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.-Txiw)
I think about that often. This fight for America is heavy too, and Jesus Christ is my inspiration.
I am a husband and a father to five children, and every waking moment I feel the weight of what we're up against.
[An evil communist-minded movement with no fear of God, working to strip away our freedom to worship, to speak, to raise our own kids by our own conscience.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
[Some days I stumble.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.) I wonder if it's worth the cost.
But Jesus Christ didn't reach the throne by ducking the burden.
[He bore the flogging and mockery and shouldered the cross to his eventual death.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.-k1LqIw)
---
[](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow._anuiMKEB6H6yOWV58b0w)
---
That message fuels me when it would be easier to stay quiet.
History won't hand us a second run at this.
That's why I'm asking you to help me carry this weight and rise to the challenge ahead.
[Whatever you can give, $25, $50, $100, is your hand under this cross with mine. ](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
Even under the heaviest load, we do not stumble alone, because Jesus Christ carried it first, and He carries it with us still.
Let's do this together.

[Chip in before midnight!](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
May God bless you and your family,
Jace Yarbrough

Before we start talking about immigration, let's correct some common misconceptions about immigration and immigrants.
First, immigrants do not hurt U.S.-born workers, and that is especially true in Alabama. Second, any violent crime is a tragedy, and undocumented immigrants do commit crimes, some of them heinous, but as a population, undocumented immigrants are less likely to commit a violent crime than either naturalized or native-born US citizens. Third, immigration contributes positively to economic growth by expanding the labor force, boosting consumer demand, and supporting overall GDP growth.
Our immigration system is broken and has led to some of the worst civil rights abuses we have seen in this country in decades. The system has to be reformed, and it should be done quickly. Reform of our immigration system needs to be based on a few core principles...

## Buried 1967 Radioactive Source Recovered
A Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) corporal's vehicle-mounted radiation detector [flagged a radioactive source buried underground](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGypSAQRL8GMyxEhGdAsInZ23RDa4TRO1UIt3C8Pv9-y_2FzTro6tPdf77nb6BEefsNO3r-Wcuc8ToSMmOdl7MSxgqRCgSmD-7AWAnSrJW2UjnZqzkCpXs2TfSLimPXoO_c12DU2FvXvHxn9fKFCsHgMA6rBRv0AIsZ4xKNHoeG_BOmXK-6Tmlj26VXXViVMja4vu9WYRRG4lJbfiHjDxxrussHaxvK3iT_Yn4fov8l9CT0dF1Xu1I9GBJWdo9H6OlBCD0p9-hR6KmWkymjfAPXkiRX2jash3zGAlPJEhLUXSaESHmT-5mYJGyYwy0rhod_y51ighxlKGfmW-ipqT6-L0qJDuuEUdsOlP715P979-P13wAAAP__sIqQjA) during a routine Friday patrol near South County Road 1210 in Midland County. A survey pinpointed a sealed cesium-137 source 6 to 8 inches below the surface, identified as a [100-millicurie unit manufactured in April 1967](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OgzAQBp_GdI7sheC4cHENXa69EvlnCSsZjGyHJG9_IlKk66_fHc18P9fxainSevu2C5r6nNK44qNErBXz6O6ZMGQbKFlfacfFVsxk4wgCei4Ub8UYLMXX2DXBOBG0bNBIdTl3Qre9amYDICGEy3TRWjknVa8dKDfJzqM8I-qGzAETqhVSCuj6k2uF9JMQXe9V28qJdQID1ZRPdcaKT1um-Eo75pNPSxPNXOtWWPvFYGAwFLva9YYxRdrxuGAwHEkMhvcvg-EjD5rBELbCZ4xb4Rn9QeV_evknmC8Uol0D9-m-1leTTdgeFCOVXrFO3BZL8a1T_zfibuA3AAD__9UEhzk). On Saturday, the DPS Radiological/Nuclear Threat Detection Unit, the FBI, state health officials, Midland fire and emergency crews, and Chevron security set up "hot" and "cold" zones and [excavated the source](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ugzAUhZ_GbKDrHyAZPHRhS9eO6Nq-JFcyOLJNSN6-StWhe8cjHZ2j7_u6zBfkyNv1E1ey9bmkeaOjRKqV8uz2zBQyBk7oKz9oxUqZMc4K1NDC2GqYA3J8zaYJ1kE4y4asHE-9gbMexuZm6ezg5AB6UigXp0zvRnCa-t5LI6lv2L7HYNQgJSgzdE6D9AuAGfyotVyEAQpcU-7qjSo9sSzxlR6UO5_WJtpbrfci9IdQk1DTcRzdK-3ZYeHt3RBqeiMJNcXkMba_4Q9V66nwvrYl7dlTu3KIuAWhpibbcD84Ri7DKAxcV-T481r_5-ph1XcAAAD__7fwfzk). DPS said the operation ended with no injuries, no contamination, and no threat to the public. The detection unit numbers just eight officers statewide, and DPS is now issuing personal radiation detectors to every trooper.

**Dear**** _Texas Flyover_****Reader,**
A month ago, the _Minnesota Star Tribune_ won a Pulitzer Prize. Last week, it announced it's cutting 15% of its staff.

That's been the shape of the whole year. In February, the _Washington Post_ eliminated more than 300 newsroom jobs and closed its sports and books desks outright. The BBC is shedding up to 2,000 roles. BuzzFeed and HuffPost cut about a third of their people. In Pittsburgh, the _Post-Gazette_ shuttered its entire opinion section and published its last editorial.

Here's what none of those outlets will say out loud: this is what happens when you spend years telling your audience what to think instead of what happened. Readers can tell when the news is tilted, and they've been walking away by the millions.

The numbers back it up. Gallup now finds just 28% of Americans trust the media to report the news fully, accurately, and fairly. That's the lowest it has ever measured.

The legacy media created this problem. _The Texas Flyover_ was built to be the solution, and the difference is simple. They editorialize in their reporting. We don't. _The Texas Flyover_ will always be free. Producing it isn't.

Fifty years ago, Alex Haley's Roots changed how this country understood its own history.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e3dabd02da88/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363780?e=dc5f639d62)

Hey friends,
**I’m thrilled to share with you episode 3 of the** _**Standing Tall**_**podcast!**
_****_
**
CLICK HERE:**[**LISTEN NOW**](https://us.list-manage.com/c8WidoC60xS?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
Fifty years ago, Alex Haley's _Roots_ changed how this country understood its own history. This year, on the anniversary of that book, a Tennessee school district [banned it](https://us.list-manage.com/1B3DA6aUpJf?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0) from library shelves — in the same city that has a 13-foot statue of Haley holding that very book.
**This week I sat down with Chris Haley (Alex Haley's great-nephew) and Bill Haley Jr. (his grandson, and a 9th-generation descendant of Kunta Kinte himself)** to talk about all of it — the cultural impact _Roots_ had in 1976, the recent ban and its reversal here in Knox County, and what it means that we're fighting some of these same battles again today. We also get into the upcoming [Roots 50th Commemorative Experience](https://us.list-manage.com/gCthoczYYwS?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), a three-day immersive tour kicking off August 7th!
This one's personal, it's historical, and it's exactly the kind of conversation we needed to have right now.
**Listen or watch now:****🎧**[**RSS/Apple**](https://us.list-manage.com/10B3lzPJFTA?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**|**[**Spotify**](https://us.list-manage.com/r1AS4pjGvSc?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**📺**[**YouTube**](https://us.list-manage.com/j6NUHTrUnmS?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
Want to be part of the Roots 50th celebration? Head to [roots50.org](https://us.list-manage.com/mZ8hufjL6pm?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0) for the full schedule and registration.
Thank you for being here,
Gloria

| | Oil steadied after the biggest daily jump in more than two weeks, as the US launched a fresh wave of strikes against targets in Iran. Brent traded near $90 a barrel after rallying by almost 8% in the previous session, while West Texas Intermediate was above $84. The oil market has now priced four ceasefire-collapse cycles in this war. April 8 ceasefire announcement: Brent –15.9%. Two days later: +8% reversal. June 17 MOU signing: Brent –$22 over a month. July 8 collapse: Brent +$10 in two days. July 25 pause: Brent –11.3% on Monday. July 29 collapse: Brent +8% same session. Each cycle compresses: the market learns faster that the ceasefire is fragile, prices the fragility sooner, and the initial decline gets shallower while the recovery gets faster. Cushing below 20 million barrels is operationally significant — at that level, pipeline minimums and tank bottom constraints begin to affect physical delivery. The July recovery briefly brought Cushing back above 20 million. The resumed war is drawing it down again. The August 11 STEO, now 12 days away, must model both the resumed war's demand on physical storage and the structural damage to Gulf supply routes that no ceasefire announcement can quickly repair.

**ICYMI: Cook Political Report Shifts OH-01 to Republican Leaning Seat**
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
**CINCINNATI, OH** — In case you missed it, the nonpartisan Cook Political Report released its updated 2026 Partisan Voting Index (PVI) this week, moving Ohio's 1st Congressional District from a Democratic-leaning seat to a district that now favors Republicans, underscoring the momentum behind Eric Conroy's campaign to flip the seat this November.
The updated Cook PVI reflects Ohio's recent redistricting, which added more of Southwest Ohio, including Republican leaning Clinton County and the western portion of Cincinnati, to the district. Under the new lines, the seat would have voted for President Trump by 2.5 points in 2024 and by 1 point during JD Vance’s 2022 Senate Campaign, a large shift from the district's previous Democratic tilt.The updated rating continues to add to the list of indicators that point to a competitive general election between Eric Conroy and Democrat Greg Landsman:

* The district's partisan lean has moved several points in Republicans' favor since the last redistricting cycle.

* Millions of dollars have already been reserved for the Cincinnati media market for this fall by national Republican groups, including the Congressional Leadership Fund.

* The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee is already spending in an effort to shore up a weak incumbent in Landsman

* President Trump endorsed Eric Conroy during the Republican primary, citing his record of service as an Air Force veteran and former CIA case officer.

“The updated Cook Political Report underscores what my campaign has been saying for months: Republicans & the voters of this district are ready for a change. This is a flippable seat for Republicans and will be critical to retaining a majority this November. I am excited that this change is being highlighted and will continue working everyday to show why my common-sense policies are what is needed to allow the Cincinnati area to prosper.” - Eric Conroy
Conroy, a Cincinnati native, U.S. Air Force veteran, and former CIA case officer, is the Republican nominee for Ohio's 1st Congressional District. He faces Democrat Greg Landsman in the November 3, 2026 general election.###

|
Peter,
The last few weeks have been terrifying for Democracy.
Trump went on primetime to resurrect his election-fraud fantasy, laying the groundwork to contest any result he doesn't like. Stephen Miller stood at the State Department and called Americans on the left a "cancer" to be "rooted out." The FBI raided the Ohio Organizing Collaborative and opened an investigation into America Votes, two groups whose only crime is registering voters.
And this week, Trump's reign of terror continues. On Monday, the State Department published a report titled "Cuba: The Capital of 21st Century Communism." Buried inside it is something that has no business existing in a free country: a list of specific American citizens, named and targeted by their own government for their politics.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GqqjHFGTZuCqhq-yosD-HFEFY_8wm-4CqbY3u_IumOPa6JiWj4dDhrywL-GRDmNVIlWvwe8mk2F9zs7L1Zt_OL-9ZPLZZ_OVx9iL6lvPojgxC1FJBujxaXd7i1Ed67altv0AaoWTmjkgFLoKbtQedoIWcTulbZsoxLf1OqRPxVBzK2li5lJJEUsRhb9UlFqSNVWe-nL7J9U0Zr1GGO1esTR5UVjYkzoYxOBH3S_lK7iMQ08CcEka-w==&c=H-GiTJT--OPCMk8WKfH8lSMH43e7AQIp7NuOnkgacdXqXLqZHvqPyQ==&ch=5uojcopDVoanDjE6wTsp_qLWWAf2zKqIg7CPJuUIMCIQYUJ4Nk5JHA==)
---
A pattern is starting to emerge.
The report singles out streamer Hasan Piker, Amazon union organizer Christian Smalls, the Democratic Socialists of America, and environmental activist Isra Hirsi, the daughter of Congresswoman Ilhan Omar. It brands them "front groups and fellow travelers" for a foreign government, and it reaches back to the McCarthy era for its playbook, holding up the blacklists and loyalty purges of the 1950s as a model that worked.
You don't have to agree with one word these people have ever said to see the danger. The instant the government starts printing lists of citizens to punish for their beliefs, the only question left is will my name get added next.
And just as terrifying, this report serves another insidious purpose: it lays the groundwork for regime change in Cuba as Trump continues to threaten an invasion. A witch hunt at home and another war abroad.
That's why Defend Our Courts' work is so critical at this moment. Trump's attempt at a fascist takeover of our country is exactly what our courts were built to stop. The judges we elect this November will play a decisive role in whether our democracy holds or not. We're fighting to expand and protect the Democratic firewall of state Supreme Courts nationwide--courts that have the power to stop Trump.
But to operate at the scale we need to at this pivotal moment requires resources we don't have yet. We need the support of Democrats everywhere to help fuel our efforts. clean_body: The instant the government starts printing lists of citizens to punish for their beliefs, the only question left is whose name will get added next. | | | | | == | Peter, The last few weeks have been terrifying for Democracy. Trump went on primetime to resurrect his election-fraud fantasy, laying the groundwork to contest any result he doesn't like. Stephen Miller stood at the State Department and called Americans on the left a "cancer" to be "rooted out." The FBI raided the Ohio Organizing Collaborative and opened an investigation into America Votes, two groups whose only crime is registering voters. And this week, Trump's reign of terror continues. On Monday, the State Department published a report titled "Cuba: The Capital of 21st Century Communism." Buried inside it is something that has no business existing in a free country: a list of specific American citizens, named and targeted by their own government for their politics. | == A pattern is starting to emerge. The report singles out streamer Hasan Piker, Amazon union organizer Christian Smalls, the Democratic Socialists of America, and environmental activist Isra Hirsi, the daughter of Congresswoman Ilhan Omar. It brands them "front groups and fellow travelers" for a foreign government, and it reaches back to the McCarthy era for its playbook, holding up the blacklists and loyalty purges of the 1950s as a model that worked. You don't have to agree with one word these people have ever said to see the danger. The instant the government starts printing lists of citizens to punish for their beliefs, the only question left is will my name get added next. And just as terrifying, this report serves another insidious purpose: it lays the groundwork for regime change in Cuba as Trump continues to threaten an invasion. A witch hunt at home and another war abroad. That's why Defend Our Courts' work is so critical at this moment. Trump's attempt at a fascist takeover of our country is exactly what our courts were built to stop. The judges we elect this November will play a decisive role in whether our democracy holds or not. We're fighting to expand and protect the Democratic firewall of state Supreme Courts nationwide--courts that have the power to stop Trump. But to operate at the scale we need to at this pivotal moment requires resources we don't have yet. We need the support of Democrats everywhere to help fuel our efforts. body:

# [](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1317?t=1&akid=966%2E3892029%2EV1ZoE3)

**This wasn’t the news I was hoping to share, Peter.**
Alex here. Last night was our final FEC deadline before the primary. I was up late refreshing our ActBlue, and we came short of our goal.
Look, I’m not going to BS you and say the sky’s falling because we didn’t hit our goal.
But here is the truth: This comes at the worst possible time. I am being hammered with attack ads from special interests right before early voting begins for the primary election. And unless we raise another $62,000 today, there’s a chance we have to pull our ads down.
But there’s still time to turn our fortunes around.

_I originally wrote this for the[American Institute for Boys and Men](https://substack.com/redirect/781627cf-3ea3-403c-a265-4a452db39872?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an advocacy group that_ _conducts nonpartisan research on issues that affect the well-being of boys and men across the United States. AIBM[published it yesterday](https://substack.com/redirect/412ad75d-a7de-4cb6-ba8b-c6a8ff3b7de2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)._
Since the [Supreme Court allowed states to legalize sports gambling](https://substack.com/redirect/4a55d6a1-1820-4e11-b5f8-e59b6d6acb2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2018, it's been an all-out land grab for FanDuel, DraftKings, and other gambling platforms: to push for state-by-state legalization, to acquire customers, and to make gambling an integral part of watching sports.
By almost every measure, they've succeeded. State-licensed sports gambling is [legal in 39 states](https://substack.com/redirect/6d9246d6-8c77-4188-9759-a3ed22b735eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); it's legal online in [27 states](https://substack.com/redirect/9bfb5bb9-3017-44f2-a26c-659061bc3ecc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).1 But as the American Institute for Boys and Men [has](https://substack.com/redirect/d5c36734-22a4-46c3-80de-6debcc43d765?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [written](https://substack.com/redirect/848bcced-346b-4e38-ad2a-f632703a8e03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [about](https://substack.com/redirect/a4a7d1fc-f8b7-4099-b0f1-1cc0ae8b6a1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [extensively](https://substack.com/redirect/c2c8b8dd-f08b-41ca-bb14-3dc3eb7e9c72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),2 this has had profound social consequences:
* When states legalize online betting, bankruptcy rates [rise as much as 30%](https://substack.com/redirect/4f1772c7-1d17-4527-a094-733c4bb3cc83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).3 One study found that for every dollar bet on sports, [investment contributions fall by 99¢](https://substack.com/redirect/f42bc236-1327-4724-a8ab-acf703341e66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).4
* When states legalize online betting, [alcohol consumption goes up](https://substack.com/redirect/63e81b16-a72f-4927-85a3-c47ac0dda7ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [calls to gambling helplines](https://substack.com/redirect/82244a08-7091-4353-bb7c-2d41ce532a45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) go up, [child maltreatment goes up](https://substack.com/redirect/f218e06e-dd7d-44d9-91e1-863e4e4f135b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [food insecurity goes up](https://substack.com/redirect/05250274-aed4-4aee-bab2-79d5d8dfae65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Problem gamblers are [much likelier to have suicidal tendencies](https://substack.com/redirect/fd47b786-3250-49ad-b633-0a75ffefc5ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Projected state tax revenues from online gambling have been [far lower than what was promised](https://substack.com/redirect/3f515bb2-87aa-422e-a2a2-6608f0f45679?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). When you factor in societal costs--higher bankruptcies, higher rates of substance abuse, more violent tendencies--[states may be ](https://substack.com/redirect/e5fd6a4d-bf6d-414f-9dcc-33fb49e4da0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[losing](https://substack.com/redirect/e5fd6a4d-bf6d-414f-9dcc-33fb49e4da0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ money](https://substack.com/redirect/e5fd6a4d-bf6d-414f-9dcc-33fb49e4da0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

When you look at young men, what we're seeing is even more concerning. So-called "prediction markets" like Kalshi, which are largely unregulated and available to any American 18 or older, are really just [sports gambling platforms](https://substack.com/redirect/9ba66918-f112-4277-8041-bf96bda3b3ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in disguise. They're exacerbating this problem.5
Most alarmingly of all, **gambling apps, prediction markets, pseudo-gambling apps, freemium games, and more are all targeting boys under 21**. These companies are creating a funnel that has young men habitually--and often problematically--gambling well before they should legally even be allowed to open an account.

### Boys under 21 can't legally gamble, but they're doing it anyway
Common Sense Media [put out a terrific report](https://substack.com/redirect/53ee2965-8a22-4f52-891a-7064e0d95644?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on how boys under 18 are gambling. Gambling is pervasive, even among boys as young as 11.6
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9392d539-b34d-441d-9aae-2e87a20f7049?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [Common Sense Media](https://substack.com/redirect/53ee2965-8a22-4f52-891a-7064e0d95644?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This isn't inherently bad. I think most parents would be fine with their teenage boys playing a poker game at home with friends, or putting a few dollars into a March Madness pool. For lots of boys under 21, it really is just that.
But home poker games don't blow up your phones with notifications, nor do they offer ACH withdrawal, nor are they available 24 hours per day.
Minors can access online casinos through offshore and unlicensed platforms, crypto casinos, or accounts belonging to parents and older siblings, all of which are common and easy workarounds. Consequently, even if it's nominally illegal, young men--who are [especially susceptible to gambling addiction](https://substack.com/redirect/daf4d18e-26b7-4fb5-a19e-dd734d141c46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--are getting themselves into serious trouble.7
There's a lot of harrowing, well-researched reporting on boys getting themselves into serious debt before they turn 18. And of course, countless other stories are never told.
* "Teen gambling is turbocharged thanks to sports-betting and prediction markets. Parents often have no idea." (_[MarketWatch](https://substack.com/redirect/5fcef786-d11e-42a8-b231-05e8aa026316?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)
* "Gamification and memes lure young people to sports wagering apps and prediction markets" (_[Associated Press](https://substack.com/redirect/83607285-81e0-4192-bcc2-53a160e6c37c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)
* "'Public health crisis': Experts weigh the stakes of youth gambling in America" ([ABC News](https://substack.com/redirect/8c9853a5-d0ff-45d3-9000-4fc03e9141c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
* "Prediction markets have made betting easier than ever--and young men are paying the price" (_[Fortune](https://substack.com/redirect/3634c53a-a438-4d6a-b0f7-62e614a6d116?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)
* "Young man reveals how online gambling put him thousands in debt before age of 18" ([ABC 7 NY](https://substack.com/redirect/752aeb62-d798-47ca-a14f-ca78468db4f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

These trends are likely to accelerate as prediction markets--which are available in every state, are less regulated, and have an age limit of 18 rather than 21--become more prevalent.
While we know that [prediction markets can feed gambling addictions](https://substack.com/redirect/b6deabe1-6f9b-4774-ac90-151f222de626?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we don't know how many of their users are under 21. That's because they're not required to disclose who's gambling on their platforms.
[Despite requests from members of Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/a7e85858-2f08-44d9-8a79-c5911a9c2767?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), these companies have opted not to share that information.
### Gambling ads reach--and target--boys under 21
Obviously, boys who are watching television are going to see the (ubiquitous) ads for FanDuel, DraftKings, Kalshi, and other platforms that are spending billions per year on advertising.8
That may not be ideal, but it's hardly unique. Beer companies get to advertise on television, and that's not meant to reach minors.
What's more alarming is that boys are _more_ likely to encounter gambling ads on platforms capable of targeting them directly (namely, [YouTube](https://substack.com/redirect/3565825f-b31b-441e-97f2-cbe24b21b40f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and social media):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd29b9b3-ef89-44de-9d12-4d8f58ebcbea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [Common Sense Media](https://substack.com/redirect/53ee2965-8a22-4f52-891a-7064e0d95644?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The content on social media can be relentless, and it seldom includes disclaimers about gambling addiction, which violates [the gambling industry's own guidelines](https://substack.com/redirect/0f5c33a7-f47e-44e0-900b-19b6deeb8f7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[FanDuel](https://substack.com/redirect/9b901b52-9f46-429b-b144-b7c87517eedc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [DraftKings](https://substack.com/redirect/178e3f94-bdda-497c-b7f6-75804b0f1173?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and others have public positions about their commitment to promoting responsible gambling and preventing minors from gambling. In practice, they don't operate that way.9
Their public comments on the topic are fairly explicit. Here are a few examples from investor presentations and earnings calls:
* Back in early 2021, [FanDuel put together slides](https://substack.com/redirect/6a8963d4-9efb-4b25-a9f9-7e3a7428885b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on "Attracting and Engaging Gen Z" and "Building a Product for Gen Z." Keep in mind that at the time, the vast majority of Gen Z wasn't of legal gambling age: approximately 20% of Gen Z was 21+, and approximately 40% was 18+.10
* FanDuel and DraftKings are actively thinking about how to make sure that young adults are in their pipeline. This question came up in a [DraftKings earnings call earlier this year](https://substack.com/redirect/8452611e-5a35-42a4-95a6-1972b1b80b74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),11 and FanDuel last year [announced the launch of FanDuel Predicts](https://substack.com/redirect/8e4d1dd3-b617-4b39-b6ad-3f1390c2968e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) explicitly as "a new prediction market product which will include sports in states without access to regulated sports betting." Prediction markets are 18+, not 21+.
* Super Group, a gambling company that [trades on the NYSE](https://substack.com/redirect/c73782cd-01ce-4b0f-accb-6275a99c02b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [spoke about](https://substack.com/redirect/ab5847c2-0dce-4cde-8771-4bb2a27e2be6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "a growing population of customers turning 18 and 21 every year" abroad as a demographic opportunity for the company.

Moreover, all of these companies are hiring brand ambassadors who are popular with people under 21. Take Pat McAfee, [who just signed a sponsorship deal with DraftKings](https://substack.com/redirect/e541f88c-ec1a-4c2b-a263-e97102ea6a32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to replace his FanDuel sponsorship deal, which was [worth up to $30 million per year](https://substack.com/redirect/859332ae-2a82-4aff-ab4f-9752e30d3ae1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He has a large TikTok following, and his content is immensely popular [among people under 18](https://substack.com/redirect/0088f0b4-d80d-4872-809e-b468f51f4353?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [among people ages 18-21](https://substack.com/redirect/19977e09-045c-42cc-9605-86eaf36d192f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who are exposed to all of his gambling content.12
Polymarket may be the most shameless, [hiring brand ambassadors in fraternities](https://substack.com/redirect/d19fd53f-6c3f-4b45-83bc-f914e9bd6ed7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and paying them to recruit new customers. [College campuses have been particularly lucrative](https://substack.com/redirect/52acbafd-7741-46af-821c-8eb5f177df4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for prediction markets.
Believe it or not, these aren't even the worst actors. [Plenty of illegal casinos](https://substack.com/redirect/2fdac433-b5c2-470b-8528-0958f487b4ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) operate without proper disclosure, operate without licenses, and target minors.13 Ads for these casinos are nominally prohibited on Instagram, YouTube, and Twitch, but they proliferate anyway, and [teenagers have found themselves deep in debt](https://substack.com/redirect/c013b954-eed6-463a-8d45-94f9d8f69552?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) well before they're legally allowed to gamble.
### What can be done?
As anyone who's ever been a teenager on the internet can attest, it's very easy to break the rules. And while some of that creativity is admirable--[a fake moustache to get around AI age verification tools](https://substack.com/redirect/b2864df5-0d91-47dd-9455-e995ebd8e296?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for instance--minors can get themselves into serious trouble before they even turn 18, much less 21. Gambling companies have little interest in keeping them from seeing their ads and sponsored content.
What's more, these companies use aggressive, predatory methods [that aren't legal elsewhere in the world](https://substack.com/redirect/272c9630-ef1c-4d92-b756-1843dab11930?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to reach new customers. U.S. regulation hasn't caught up.
Four policies that are obvious and urgent:
1. **Regulate advertising for prediction markets**. Right now, [they're basically unregulated](https://substack.com/redirect/399e3d8c-4487-4e59-9ece-ef005f673ccb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That's a regulatory oversight at best, and they should be subject to the sorts of rules that other online casinos face.
2. **Require more extensive disclosures**. For prediction markets, how many 18-to-20-year-olds are using these platforms? How many minors are trying to create accounts? How much of their content on social media is being seen by minors?14
3. **Limit how much young gamblers can wager per month**. Flutter, an Ireland-based gambling company, [limits gamblers under 25 to £500 per month](https://substack.com/redirect/272c9630-ef1c-4d92-b756-1843dab11930?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That should be enshrined in American regulation.
4. **Crack down on illegal gambling**. Crypto casinos and other unlicensed offshore casinos [are operating in the U.S. without consequence](https://substack.com/redirect/f9977134-69c1-4501-8d10-bfb841cc2062?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). State and federal regulators must do better to enforce the laws already on the books.

This is a perpetual game of regulatory cat-and-mouse. Despite what they'll tell you, gambling platforms are reliant on high-frequency problem gamblers, who drive much of the platforms' profits. They know that young men in particular are especially vulnerable--and, therefore, especially lucrative.

Public discourse _is_ starting to shift on this issue, and Americans are likelier to say that [legal sports gambling is bad for society](https://substack.com/redirect/13703d4d-320b-4733-8660-55d34193ed68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than they were a few years ago.
It's not the primary societal concern, but athletes are speaking up about the harassment they're dealing with. At a press conference during the British Open, professional golfer Matt Fitzpatrick articulated the [abuse athletes face from gamblers](https://substack.com/redirect/83354d98-039d-4d07-b8be-a2fc1cb447c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It's why the NCAA has called for [an end to prop bets on college athletes](https://substack.com/redirect/dde9225e-d94b-43e2-b575-8214d9ea10d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who receive all kinds of threats.
2
I have also [written](https://substack.com/redirect/5bda3256-18c8-46c7-9e00-04d7c5220a0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [about](https://substack.com/redirect/cb052b73-bd9d-469f-ae7e-e9df4bac13b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [this](https://substack.com/redirect/467a37d3-d558-4b8c-aa7b-bb2f7c5cda2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [extensively](https://substack.com/redirect/ffd05a46-15a7-4e78-a0b9-c7acae05a6e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which is why AIBM and I are partnering on this topic.
3
That's within just four years of legalization.
4
What other studies find isn't [quite so dramatic](https://substack.com/redirect/d6b74317-8753-4c6d-9755-0581f26e59f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but what's clear across all of the research is that this isn't just entertainment money. It's replacing savings for retirement.
5
As a primer on gambling apps, prediction markets, etc.:
* Conventional sportsbooks generally require customers to be 21.
* Prediction markets generally require customers to be 18.
* Illegal casinos and other pseudo-gambling products reach children much younger than that.
* All of them have rules that can be circumvented.

6
Data from the NCAA tells us that the rates of gambling increase after people turn 18. [58% of 18- to 22-year-olds](https://substack.com/redirect/1680a464-f2f4-4252-be12-a5826be2658f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and 67% of students living on college campuses--have bet on sports alone. (Which means, presumably, that rates of gambling defined more broadly are even higher.)
7
Good data on what constitutes "serious trouble" is challenging to come by, but this chart tells an interesting story:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f55ec845-1b13-4812-8f59-5453b3f000c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [Common Sense Media](https://substack.com/redirect/53ee2965-8a22-4f52-891a-7064e0d95644?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
There is more than one way that gambling can be problematic. But using your parents' credit cards without their knowledge is unquestionably problematic behavior--even if it doesn't constitute a formal gambling addiction.
8
According to SEC filings, in the year ending December 31, 2025:
* DraftKings spent about [$1.1 billion on advertising](https://substack.com/redirect/da034bfa-0099-44cc-810f-99c490976b6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* FanDuel spent about [$1.3 billion on advertising](https://substack.com/redirect/65cca11b-0ed2-47a2-b000-e87f613cbb4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The same data is not available for companies like Kalshi, which aren't publicly traded and therefore don't have the same disclosure requirements. It's nonetheless clear that these companies are spending fortunes on advertising.
9
This remains one of my favorite _SNL_ sketches:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/919f3cb2-22b0-453d-98ed-c6701731488b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
10
This is some pretty back-of-the-envelope math, [assisted by ChatGPT](https://substack.com/redirect/858445c2-4f66-4b6b-9d10-9eaac1b6402d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It still roughly checks out if you assume an even distribution during Gen Z's birth years of 1997-2012.
11
Specifically, the [question from an analyst](https://substack.com/redirect/8452611e-5a35-42a4-95a6-1972b1b80b74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (emphasis added):
> Just on customer growth and MUP [monthly unique payer] growth, I realize it was up low single digits ex the lottery. Can you just talk about trends there? I think there's a slide in your shareholder deck that says 30% of volume -- of Prediction Market volume in regulated states is coming from regulated markets. **Is there something where younger customers that are like 18 to 20 just aren 't shifting over to DraftKings as they get older?** Or can you just talk about the MUP trends?
12
It's worth noting that the predatory behavior isn't limited to minors. MLB star Bryce Harper [sent a video to a FanDuel client](https://substack.com/redirect/d14e8331-6cd3-4031-82ce-cb36dcc2ccc3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as part of that gambler's VIP treatment. (Bryce Harper, somewhat implausibly in my view, [denies that he had any knowledge](https://substack.com/redirect/ea55c3ab-19e5-4b52-ba4e-cf21ebdb6878?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of what was going on.)
13
Sometimes, minors are gambling with real money. In other cases, they're gambling for things like "[skins](https://substack.com/redirect/7ca84571-a5c2-43f5-b390-31a200d947c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," which are limited-edition costumes for video game characters, some of which [can go for thousands of dollars](https://substack.com/redirect/2fdac433-b5c2-470b-8528-0958f487b4ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at auction.
14
The information available to advertisers on social media is so expansive that this data surely exists.

He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Fellow Patriot. # [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2593%2E5691347%2EvnIKyy)

Peter, it’s Jon.
I don’t love asking for money. Does anyone?
