To refresh your memory: After the 2024 elections and the defeat of a MAGA candidate for governor, opponents of voting rights in North Carolina jammed through a bill that took the power of the governor to appoint people to election boards and handed that to the state auditor . It's worth noting that the state auditor is the only statewide elected Republican, with Democrats winning the 2024 races for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, and secretary of state.
Now, among massive protests from young voters, the MAGA-fied North Carolina State Elections Board recently shot down proposals to continue having early voting sites on several universities around the state . These weren't new sites either; these were places where North Carolina had provided early voting locations for a decade or more.
This is voter suppression, plain and simple, by making it harder for eligible, registered voters to vote in-person by taking away their polling place. It's another demonstration of how opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections.
We have to fight these suppressive actions in North Carolina and any other state where opponents of voting rights try to replicate this. Peter,
As primary season begins to wrap up, we're shifting our focus to the next phase of this election: **defeating Republicans and flipping seats from red to blue.**
And for the past several months, Leaders We Deserve has been focused on building a stronger Democratic Party by supporting a new generation of bold, young leaders in key primaries across the country.
That work isn't stopping. _It's expanding._
We have to elect Democrats who are willing to fight — and we have to defeat Republicans who are making life harder for millions of Americans.
That's why we're proud to support candidates like **Randy Villegas** in California.
Randy isn't taking corporate PAC money. He's focused on lowering costs, protecting working families, and delivering the kind of leadership people in his district have been asking for.
_It's working._
**Right now, Randy is leading Republican Congressman David Valadao by 4 points.**
That isn't happening by accident.
It's happening because voters — especially young voters — are hungry for leaders who understand what it's like to live paycheck to paycheck, who share their values, and who aren't beholden to wealthy special interests.
For too many people, politics feels hopeless. They see billionaires and corporate interests calling the shots, and they wonder whether their vote even matters.
The answer isn't to give up — it's to elect leaders who prove that the government can still work for ordinary people.
That's exactly what Leaders We Deserve is doing.
But flipping competitive districts takes resources, and we're coming up on an important end-of-month fundraising deadline.
We're working to raise **$100,000 before midnight on July 31** so we can help candidates like Randy communicate with voters, organize on the ground, and defeat Republicans in some of the most competitive races in the country.

David Hogg

clean_body: A note on election security | | | | The President's speech this month should have been about lowering costs and creating jobs. Instead, he continued spreading lies about American elections. The truth, however, is simple: 1. Donald Trump lost the 2020 election. 2. America's elections are secure, transparent, and run by state and local officials from both parties. After the 2020 election, the CIA, the Department of Justice, the Department of Homeland Security, and other agencies investigated the vote and found no evidence of foreign interference. More than 60 courts rejected challenges to the outcome of the 2020 election. Republican and Democratic election officials alike confirmed the results. There was no evidence of widespread fraud that changed the outcome of the election. Case closed. Ahead of Election Day, I am supporting all efforts to protect access to the ballot box, defend Washington state's secure vote-by-mail system, and ensure election officials have the resources they need to administer free and fair elections. On Election Day, I will work to stop voter intimidation and ensure polling places around the country remain open. After Election Day, I will work to ensure all ballots are counted. body:
Finally, some good news!
| Fellow Patriot,
---
What a turnaround!
---
After poll after poll showed the Democrats trouncing us in voter enthusiasm all year, the latest polling shows MAGA has finally regained the upper hand!
---
**Newsweek: “MAGA More Motivated Than Democrats for 2026 Midterms: Poll”**

“Trump/MAGA Republicans were the most likely to say they were "definitely going to vote" in the 2026 congressional midterm elections on November 3: **75 percent of MAGA respondents expressed that enthusiasm** [compared to] **63 percent of Democrats.”**
---
The best part? Our Party’s FIRST-EVER Midterm Convention at the end of the summer is the perfect opportunity to boost GOP voter enthusiasm even _further_!
---
__For MAGA, only 75% of our voters being “high propensity” who will “definitely” vote in the midterms is still close to the floor. We need to be aiming for the ceiling, which is 100%!__
---
But before I get ahead of myself, I want to highlight something important:
---
“Voter enthusiasm ahead of an election is... an early indicator of turnout strength and campaign engagement, **_although self-reported voting intention does not necessarily translate into actual turnout.”_ **
---
That last part is why we can’t take our foot off the gas for even a second.
---
**We need to capitalize on this new lead in enthusiasm by verifying every last Republican voter to ensure that they’re a “high propensity” voter who is actually going to show up to vote on – _or before_ – November 3rd. **
---
As long as we do that, we’ll win the midterms!
---
Given the vital importance of voter verification, I took it upon myself to review our Party’s list of voter profiles that were not fully verified as “high propensity” voters.
---
I’ll admit – I was surprised to see your name on there, Fellow Patriot.
---
_That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask _YOU_ to fully verify your profile. Because if we fully verify the remaining 25% of MAGA voters, our advantage will become insurmountable! _

name: Dylan for Wisconsin
subject: We Don’t Ride the Pollercoaster
body:
Campaigns are full of ups and downs. It's easy to get caught up in the day-to-day and lose sight of the bigger picture.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ac49f797f177/c2y1sg9w12-10123229?e=f59034ca3e)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/12e2MP5e44L?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,
Campaigns are full of ups and downs. It's easy to get caught up in the day-to-day and lose sight of the bigger picture, especially when politics feels so all-consuming.This week, we finally had a poll come out in the Treasurer’s race, and it showed two big things:
1. _**We are a little behind our opponent right now - 13% to 21%**_

2. _**66%, two-thirds of Wisconsin Democrats, are undecided on this race heading into the final two weeks**_

---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/75VvXBvMh5N?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |
_State Navigator Poll, July 2026_
---
| |
It hurts when you work so hard, and you’re not out front, but that’s exactly why I’m not taking anything for granted! With so many voters still undecided, I am doubling down, expanding who we are targeting in our digital ads, buying more lit, and getting out to meet voters across Wisconsin. We are organizing to connect with people at early voting sites across Wisconsin and stay focused through the final stretch.
Because, despite the ups and downs, we cannot ever find ourselves riding the pollercoaster.
[_**To reach more voters, to win early votes, and keep us going through the finish line, we need your support.**_](https://us.list-manage.com/13Mur2F1QzV?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
[_**Every contribution – whether it's $10, $25, or $100 – helps us travel the state, print campaign materials, and connect with voters in communities large and small. Can you donate to help us win this race, come from behind, and be a part of making Public Power Work for the Public Good?**_](https://us.list-manage.com/LGh_w3xdQzv?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
I'm so incredibly grateful for everyone who has supported this campaign, whether you've donated, signed our signature forms, put up a yard sign, or shared our message with a friend.
Let’s get this done! Thank you for your support.
Sincerely,Dylan

Hi team,
I was born and raised in Pottsville. My family has lived in Berks and Schuylkill counties for 10 generations. Our campaign office is just a couple of blocks from where I grew up, by a little patch of woods I used to play in as a kid.
The people Dan Meuser kicked off their health care are my neighbors. The families struggling because Meuser's votes raised costs are the ones I grew up with. I know the problems facing our part of PA because this is my home.
**Dan Meuser doesn 't even live here.** **And he definitely doesn 't care about the people who do.**
We deserve better than a representative who treats our district like nothing more than the background for a photo op. We deserve someone who understands us, who listens to us, and who will fight for us. **I will always fight for my home.**
**[But I can 't do this without you. Will you chip in before our end-of-month deadline tomorrow to help me give our communities the representation we deserve?](https://substack.com/redirect/ee9f3f0f-4529-4391-99a7-21b6272d6fb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

From here, for here.
- Rachel Wallace

body:
Imagine the massive impact we can have if we reach the millions of eligible Latino voters who are not yet registered.
#
Peter,
**Three recent polls show that Latino voters are backing Democrats in this upcoming midterm election.**
And in all three polls, Democrats hold a 22+ point lead over Republicans among Latino voters.
These numbers reflect voters who are _already_ registered and engaged. **Imagine the massive impact we can have if we reach the millions of eligible Latino voters who are not yet registered.**
[**Will you rush a $3 donation to help us register, inform, and mobilize unregistered Latino voters in 22 critical House battleground districts — where the Latino vote could be the difference between victory and defeat?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260730-2.Ve_ACh&amount=3&refcode=em20260730-430&t=1&akid=430%2E1366028%2ENqXKlv)
In 2024, Donald Trump reached 48 percent support among Latino voters — that surge helped Republicans take control of the White House and both chambers of Congress.
Now, control of Congress is on the line this November, and the good news is that momentum is shifting fast.
In the 2025 governor’s races in New Jersey and Virginia, Democratic candidates crushed those 2024 gains with Latino voters. Also, in Texas, Latino primary turnout surged, with the vast majority participating in the Democratic primary back in March.
**With Latinos now making up 15% of the national electorate, our community holds the key to flipping the House and Senate majorities.**
Registered Latino voters are already making their voices heard, but **the _real_ key to winning these tight races is bringing unregistered voters off the sidelines.**
That’s why we’re on the ground in 22 target districts in states like Arizona, Georgia, and Texas, making sure eligible voters have the information and tools they need to register and cast a ballot this fall.
**[Will you chip in $3 today to help us register and mobilize voters in the districts that will decide control of Congress?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260730-2.Ve_ACh&amount=3&refcode=em20260730-430&t=2&akid=430%2E1366028%2ENqXKlv)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

name: Paige for Congress
subject: Today marks 61 years of Medicare
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Paige Beauchemin for Congress
body:
It's time for Medicare for All!
| |
---
Power, Prosperity, Peace
| Dear Friends, July 30 marks the 61st anniversary of the Social Security Amendments of 1965, the legislation that created Medicare (as well as Medicaid). Millions of people gained health insurance. Americans aged 65 and older attained near-universal healthcare coverage. This was remarkable, especially considering only a little more than half of older Americans even had hospital insurance prior to Medicare. Despite this huge accomplishment, our country still severely lags behind other countries of similar means. The United States spends about twice as much as similar Western developed countries on healthcare but has worse health outcomes. To this day, 8% of Americans remain uninsured. People are going without the care they need. People are going bankrupt just to stay alive. **This is unacceptable. It is time for Medicare for All.** Our opponent promises healthcare for all but has not taken a stance on Medicare for All or any single payer healthcare platform. Meanwhile, polls show the majority of Americans support Medicare for All, with one survey showing[******65% of American voters support Medicare for All**](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/kzDZjNfNHaGrbWIgBpMBWGulm6ekmKUL/click?signature=d7d40c3312b875495b0fab0f1065638a724d239f&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dataforprogress.org%2Fblog%2F2025%2F11%2Fmedicare-for-all-is-popular-even-when-put-up-against-attacks)**.** Our campaign is championing what people want: an expanded and improved version of a program that has been serving our country for six decades. To support our campaign and its push for Medicare for All, please share this message and follow us. body:

I am ready to continue his legacy. | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=576bfccb1cb74d02abb675c53bfac66c&_e=IAnyYRnwIZ63d7fVsRccWXQmutqiJFmm1pK5wlVUO2pf1O97GzL9aafRgtBoFj0i4NJMDnzyRACuBEw3Muhq8M9xHrw6iGNl9fx2n7ID-6W_IwRJrd-640WZWeXdJPLl6GpxkIl0T22ufPmIpuknTcPTMYfMcHwTnoW1On2060RlwXMSbscKJFaDwYtgV3E95U-3hw_jr87JpxSfuF5f4rJ81m0SSk1E_btPqxp15_DJlnoRu3hfm2py70jge5Bmj_GtyKmYqeJ-vCTUxLbBi9DKPmE7iZY9zRcsMZM5pA64YLPSQMsDCed54N4yUnN_9ArsCa41Nk37QpbpOhh6Xag4dETFUDeFLAWAZQVuAR7SNI2RnTbR4zGgnLpusGzn51M8Hnpp1mfs6fa_5IBrlQDfdSxQJqCdXHv_9c5tFk3yMtHRnfdjgkMj4k7_pUxZ2lpAfYzwanLgaVQZibJFlCuTzsw3OJZQjM-aNYVN4d--KPawksL-XeCCrui09QHIEQvB97WQcZ1DMAmstAUvtTxXgSgtd2werpI_6my44t8JVihqczMR0xZIzHDXutmjJMdAiYS6pCO45mX6bvsuQqXxE3dQ901IomFedSzt-i_4_R7ZpQUhb3AbDTXXN8L81td-lic63dz8bQb-z3egkNXw0PTRDw1YXk7gykn51r6sP8bcLwHejbHOTBzmuuWBxJVYdYBb1V6xspz9xaKfL1k9Mwvf4Nz_0pgYB0DEYHFSJX-p1Lkx7bWeUYaUWVnB)
---
Peter,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I did not seek this moment, Peter.

I am ready to continue his legacy. | Peter, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Peter. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. #
Peter,
We have exactly one week left to help Justice Democrat Justin J. Pearson win his primary race in Tennessee’s 9th district and send him to the November general election.
**[Our last 2026 primary is next Thursday, August 6th, and we’re entering the most critical stretch of this fight. If you’re already with us, rush a donation to Justin’s campaign and Justice Democrats now to help us take home another win >>](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260730-1-jp.WTPQPm&refcode=em20260730-38105&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=38105%2E1203867%2E6YC5bq)**

_Justin’s path to this moment hasn’t been easy._
As a state representative and member of the Tennessee Three, he faced the full weight of the racist Republican machine — the same politicians who tried to gerrymander his community off the map and silence Black voices as he gained momentum. He’s up against a rigged status quo and billionaires who have spent decades protecting wealthy interests while working families struggle to get by.
**But if they thought they could break Justin’s spirit, they were wrong.**
Justin is a relentless fighter for the working families of Tennessee. Whether it was being expelled from the state legislature for demanding action on gun violence or standing up to corporate giants like xAI data centers, he’s proven his resilience time and time again.
And to quote Justin himself: _“The only way we lose this country, this democracy, is by quitting — but if we never quit, we can never lose.”_
That means we can’t quit now, Peter. Not when we’re this close to sending another unapologetic, progressive champion to Washington. Justin is ready to join the fight for Medicare for All, a living wage, environmental justice, getting corporate money out of politics, and for a government that _actually_ serves its people.
**We need to reach every voter in TN-09 before it’s too late.** And because Justin refuses to take a single cent from corporate PACs, he’s relying entirely on this grassroots team to fuel this final push.
**[Split a donation to Justin’s campaign and Justice Democrats today to make sure we have the resources to win our final primary of the cycle next Thursday!](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260730-1-jp.WTPQPm&refcode=em20260730-38105&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=4&akid=38105%2E1203867%2E6YC5bq)**

In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

| | **Peter – Can I share 5 “hot takes” that seem to get me in trouble with Republicans? ⬇️**

**1.** ICE shouldn’t be _killing people_ in the streets and building concentration camps in our communities.

**2.** There’s a gun violence epidemic in this country, and we _must_ ban assault weapons to address it.

**3.** We need to pass Medicare for All, so that _no one_ has to pick between a doctor's bill and rent.

**4.** We _must_ pass a data center moratorium to protect our power grid and our planet.

**5.** And lastly... Billionaires shouldn’t be able to _BUY ELECTIONS!!_

**But Peter, these aren’t exactly “hot takes” when you aren’t funded by billionaires and corporate PACs.** To regular people like us, they're just common sense.

But here’s the truth: if we’re going to pass these policies, we need more people in Congress who are willing to fight for them.

Trump walked into the Oval Office to talk about airport infrastructure and walked out having told the country that America's air traffic control towers are "literally falling down"--not one has--and that grass "is a life also." That was the warm-up. Over the next several minutes he misplaced Mardi Gras by five months, called the United Kingdom a "prime suspect," shrugged off a direct question about Xi arming Iran, and reached for "the Star War thing" when he meant a monorail. David Shuster has the whole tape, in sequence, and in sequence it is considerably worse than whichever twenty seconds of it crossed your feed.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.JIk0Kn6Mip28Y6lkjSUA8N7xLRZHBHguZGyZeAbrcKk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=209128031)
But the glitch reel is not why this one is behind the wall. In the back half of that same news conference, Trump talked himself from annihilation to grace and back inside a single breath--and from there the segment turns to the story almost nobody in American media is covering yet. An oil inventory curve that has been running down for weeks. A Persian Gulf that Iran has said it will keep closed. And a date that the analysts who trade this for a living have started circling on the calendar. Shuster names the date, the number you will see at the pump, and the long-dead president Trump is now being measured against. If they are right, the grass line will be the least of it.
_**Cliff 's Note:**_ The first half of David's piece is a glitch reel. Glitch reels are cheap--every outlet in America can cut one, and most of them did this week. The second half is not cheap. That is David doing the work almost nobody in this business is doing right now: reading the oil inventory curve, talking to the people who trade this stuff for a living, and putting a date and a number on something that is going to show up in your gas tank and your grocery bill before Labor Day. That reporting costs money. It costs David's time and it costs ours, and we do not have a hedge fund or a billionaire standing behind us. We have you.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.JIk0Kn6Mip28Y6lkjSUA8N7xLRZHBHguZGyZeAbrcKk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=209128031)
So here is the ask. [Sixty dollars a year--five bucks a month, less than a sandwich--puts you behind the wall for everything we do, and it is what lets us keep David chasing the story instead of chasing clicks.](https://substack.com/redirect/271c7bac-335a-42e2-ae00-2ac425e468aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If you are already paying: thank you. You are the reason this exists.
If you are not, this is a good week to start.
_**-- Cliff**_

Hi Derek, Before I tell you a story about this old black and white photograph I keep in my office, [**will you chip in $10 to help us take back the Senate?**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=14&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_073026_photograph&akid=10025%2E5257348%2EUrHVjY) The photo is of my grandfather, Harry, standing beside President Dwight D. Eisenhower and Senator Henry Cabot Lodge. They're bathed in sunlight on a crisp day, a crowd around them, and Harry is wearing an enormous “WIN WITH IKE” button on his lapel: [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=15&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_073026_photograph&akid=10025%2E5257348%2EUrHVjY) My grandfather — on my mother’s side — was a Republican County chairman who was deeply involved in local politics in Massachusetts. All my life, I never heard my grandfather say “Democrat.” _It was always those “damn Dems.”_ My mother Sherri stayed a Republican most of her whole life. My father, Ed, was a proud Roosevelt Democrat. He told me he was a Democrat because the Democrats helped ordinary people while the Republicans “didn’t do shit for them.” Political debates at the dinner table were routine but always civil. My brother was more on my mother's side. I took my father's. But none of us ever doubted we believed in the same common good — we just disagreed on how to get there. That’s what democracy is supposed to look like. It’s unrecognizable from what you see today, _because this is not my mother’s Republican Party._ Trump reported $2.3 billion in income last year — more than triple what he made before taking office. All while driving up costs for Americans on health care, groceries, and gas. It’s self-dealing with the presidential seal attached — all while the Republican majority in the Senate looks the other way, or worse. **[The only way to hold the line against Donald Trump’s corrupt takeover is to secure a Democratic Senate majority in November. If you’re with me in this fight, will you make a contribution of $10 to help us take back the Senate?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=16&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_073026_photograph&akid=10025%2E5257348%2EUrHVjY)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [DONATE $10→](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=17&amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=aschiff_email_073026_photograph&akid=10025%2E5257348%2EUrHVjY)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | A few people are collecting government checks that have nothing to do with taxes or Social Security. | No applications. After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

clean_body: Lindsey worked so hard, for so long for this state. I am ready to continue his legacy. | Peter, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Peter. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 3 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. I know that having people like you in his corner meant everything to him. God bless, Darline Graham P.S. It's been a difficult few weeks. name: Mandela Barnes
subject: I am leaving this race, but I will never leave the fight for Wisconsin.
body:
Last night, I had a conversation with my staff, we are proud of everything we have accomplished and the resources we have raised to spread our message, but it’s become clear who our Democratic nominee is going to.
I said from the moment I launched this campaign, my number one goal has always been to beat Tom Tiffany and deliver big wins for Democrats up and down the ticket. Now, it’s time to come together and focus all our efforts on that goal.
We must beat Tom Tiffany, it’s a life or death issue for Wisconsinites who have already lost their healthcare under a Trump administration, who can’t afford care for their children, who are being squeezed by bills while the rich continue to get richer.
I got into this race because we are living in a rigged system — the rich are getting richer and richer while the rest of us are left scrambling for crumbs, I know it firsthand and have always fought for better from my start as a community organizer.
I am leaving this race, but I will never leave the fight for Wisconsin.
I am grateful for everyone who has supported and joined my campaign. For everyone who believed in me and the opportunities we can create for Wisconsinites with bold action.
We all must do everything we can to defeat Tom Tiffany. That’s what I am committed to doing for the next 96 days.
\- Mandela Barnes

Hey folks,
Today's conversation with [Jack Cocchiarella](https://open.substack.com/users/112946688-jack-cocchiarella?utm_source=mentions) covered a lot more than Mitch McConnell. We got into transparency, accountability, corruption, and what it actually means to govern when the people in power stop answering basic questions. We even survived some live tech chaos along the way.
This one gets personal because it isn't just about one senator. It's about whether our government owes the public honesty--and what happens when the people around powerful politicians decide secrecy is the better option. You don't want to miss this one.
* **00:01:08** -- We dive into why so many political influencers avoid taking real positions and what that says about incentives in today's media landscape.
* **00:05:00** -- The conversation shifts to Mitch McConnell, Andy Beshear's demand for transparency, and why a simple public statement has become such a major issue.
* **00:11:30** -- We unpack the broader problem of accountability in Washington, from disappearing lawmakers to staff shielding powerful politicians while ordinary Americans pay the price.
* **00:18:05** -- A live technical meltdown somehow turns into an even deeper conversation about who's really making decisions when elected officials can no longer do the job themselves.
* **00:28:05** -- We close with a bigger debate about Democratic leadership, the 2028 race, and why restoring accountability--not just winning elections--has to be the priority.

This episode goes beyond the headlines. We talk about the culture of Washington, the incentives that reward secrecy over honesty, and why transparency still matters even when the news cycle moves on. If you care about accountability, the future of the Democratic Party, or simply want a candid conversation about where we are as a country, this is one you should watch. **If you value honest conversations like this, help me keep them going.**

name: Troy Jackson
subject: How we win this race and defeat Susan Collins
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121392?t=6&akid=27061%2E878179%2E5mHbYN) Team,

Growing up in Allagash and spending years working 80-hour weeks in the woods to make ends meet, I know firsthand what working Mainers need from our government.

And for 30 years, Susan Collins has failed us. Time and again, she has sold us out to Donald Trump and his MAGA agenda while pretending we’re too dumb to notice. **And I’m sick of it.**

My name is Troy Jackson. I’m a proud Mainer, father, and fifth-generation logger.

[I’ve officially earned the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate. Now it’s time to defeat Susan Collins and her billionaire backers. So I’m asking you to split a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project to become a Founding Donor to my campaign right now and help us win the most important Senate race in the country. ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121392?t=7&akid=27061%2E878179%2E5mHbYN)__ | [DONATE NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121392?t=8&akid=27061%2E878179%2E5mHbYN)
---
Friend, let me tell you a bit about what this race means to me.

When I was growing up, I was a poor kid in a town full of poor kids. My family relied on food assistance at times. I distinctly remember when I was 13 years old, we didn’t have heat or running water, and I heard my mother quietly crying to herself, wishing she could do more for us.

After high school, I became a logger like my dad, and his dad, and his dad before him. When a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages, I fought back. A whole bunch of politicians, including then-first-term Senator Susan Collins, promised to listen, but they left us high and dry — and I realized that _nothing would change_ unless there were working-class voices in power.

So I ran for the Maine legislature, where I served 20 years, including six years as the President of the Maine Senate. It’s been the honor of my life to fight for working people.

I drove hours each way between the North Woods and the State Capitol, because that's what the job required. I won those elections in a district that went for Trump by 20 points, because up here, people care less about a label and more about whether you give a damn about their family.

Team, I’m building this campaign the right way. With grassroots support from folks like you. I’m not running to impress the billionaires or the corporate class. I’m running for the mom who’s worried about how she’ll fill her gas tank this week. I’m running for the kid whose whole life will be determined by the quality of his education. I’m running to ensure every working family in Maine has the government they deserve.

[If you believe in this fight and our movement, I’m humbly asking you to split a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project today to help us reach our fundraising goal and take on the GOP’s millions. Even $5 makes a difference »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121392?t=9&akid=27061%2E878179%2E5mHbYN)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Troy Jackson and VPP will go through immediately:

Troy Jackson

name: Tim Walz
subject: Trump is waging an unprecedented political retribution campaign against us.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
I will not stand by and let this president hurt Minnesotans in his petty quest for revenge.
#
Peter,
Donald Trump is absolutely obsessed with Minnesota.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260730-2.kB8NcA&amount=5&refcode=em20260730-914&t=2&akid=914%2E34582%2EAHSq3L)
Not only is he constantly posting about us on social media, but offline **he’s waging an unprecedented political retribution campaign against our state that’s hurting people in real-time.**
He spent months terrorizing the city of Minneapolis with ICE occupation.
He attacked our immigrant communities with racist insults and conspiracy theories.
He issued bogus subpoenas in a politically motivated DOJ investigation into me and other MN elected officials.
He let DOGE and Elon Musk cancel grants for critical services like wildfire prevention to give tax breaks to billionaires and punish states like ours that voted against him.
He’s sending election monitors to Minnesota to intimidate voters and rig our elections.
And now he’s halted almost $200 million in Medicaid funds for struggling Minnesotans.
The president is also trying to help elect MAGA extremists like MyPillow CEO Mike Lindell in Minnesota this November in an attempt to expand his power and stop us from holding him accountable.
**Trump can insult me all he wants, but I will not stand by and let him wreak havoc, undermine the law, and hurt Minnesotans in his petty quest for revenge.**
With Small Town PAC, we’re working to unseat Trump’s toadies in Congress and replace them with Democratic leaders who will fight for working people instead of an extreme agenda.
**[Tomorrow is our July end-of-month deadline, and we’re still short of reaching our $50,000 goal. Can I count on you to chip in $5, 25, 50, or more to fuel our fight?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260730-2.kB8NcA&amount=5&refcode=em20260730-914&t=3&akid=914%2E34582%2EAHSq3L)**

With gratitude,
Tim

Tim Walz started Small Town PAC to build a Democratic Party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.
**[It’s time for Democrats to expand the map and put small towns back at the forefront: pitch in now to help build our movement from the ground up.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260730-914&t=23&refcode2=914_34582_AHSq3L&akid=914%2E34582%2EAHSq3L)**

subject: We're in an affordable housing crisis.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by George Latimer for Congress
body:
No family should have to spend over half of their income on housing.

George Latimer is a lifelong Westchester resident who has built a career in public service by delivering unparalleled progressive results for local residents. Now, he's taking that work to the next level by serving as your Congressman, representing New York's 16th District. If you’d like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/-Phg2RhDIEGJVPbb5vK87g2?unsubscribedata=zA4qK6dVfsUPNN1%2F60q35EGU6Rt4Cns6LtfnG3G%2B6uoHQJIYrQqB4%2FJnz4cYkbUBPHNKsx3eJizkDQRYUMAYoMN%2BcrQJBu6XZOCxPstCg%2BnjoznJW0yGYb6fRWpXRPXwIsxPKhpnqqbk5YfVqMnxDWi9kPAL7NvRbX3RXZkZS6zt199eNmmBsDSiG%2F4OOuFmjJAK0l%2Bi1QM85kKbvJDX8%2BQWnOKJdtxxfZ4ISC2ywBXXUTtx2BjvKGze%2BbjTZPMpFax3TgnVA%2B4bKpv6TA8cheR3lgbxxDlkxtuVF4DrTz0PQPd6LkSgiSfQPLnZs3TX%2FfmJHLsdzU1YCGnWTxOZoLZHR2HEz8Y8%2BVxrYZpxOAzrKBCt92%2BbsbaViejAeUuUOF64TdTYjfP0OUcmr0cqo71J57Wjr7MHwz381FblDtr%2FBPaiLTzErrU%2Bs88TIx5H)

Peter, we’re in an affordable housing crisis. The president says that no one cares about housing, but families in New York and across the country are having to choose between just getting by and building a future. Here in New York, a typical family would need to spend **65%** of their income just to afford an average home. That’s unacceptable. **No family should have to spend more than half of their income on housing.** Congress needs to come together to fully tackle this affordability problem, instead of catering to Trump’s reckless demands. **Our top priority should always be serving the communities we represent.** When I was county executive, I worked to construct affordable housing units and deliver options for families looking to move to or stay in Westchester. And in Congress, I just introduced two bills aimed at helping families better afford homes and allowing seniors to age in place. I’m committed to fighting this affordability crisis and delivering for the folks here in NY-16. That’s why this November we need to elect steady, responsible leaders who are focused on results, not those who’ll continue bowing down to Trump’s demands. **[So I have to ask, Peter: can you chip in $10 to my re-election campaign before our end-of-month fundraising deadline? name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Gregg Hull - Unfiltered
body:
His plans for New Mexico and his TIGHT race against Haaland | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/9xOf1_GVJxN?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | | New Mexico put a 15-year-old boy in a car, drove him to El Paso, and told him to walk across the bridge into Mexico by himself.

So who signed off on that?

That's the first thing we asked **Gregg Hull** on Wednesday. He was mayor of Rio Rancho for 12 years and he's the Republican running for governor against Deb Haaland.

**We had him for**[**a full hour**](https://us.list-manage.com/mR4Z7zokc6D?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)**and asked LOTS of important questions. He didn't dodge any of it**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/PO2EQAHbvBa?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | **🚨 THE STATE WALKED A BOY TO THE MEXICAN BORDER AND LEFT HIM THERE**

CYFD is the agency that's supposed to protect New Mexico kids. They had custody of this one and drove him to the border anyway. Then Texas found him and called CYFD to hand him back.

What the agency said next is the part that set Gregg off, and you need to hear him read it out loud. He's asking for something now that nobody in Santa Fe is going to want to hand over.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/H23szCUFNL9?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | **💰 HULL WANTS TO END THE STATE INCOME TAX. THAT'S $2.2 BILLION BACK TO US.**

Everybody in Santa Fe says you can't do that unless you raise some other tax to cover it. Gregg says that's wrong, and he works the numbers right there on the show. It comes down to the oil and gas money and one thing about a dollar that most people never think about.

And that $250 check the governor keeps talking about? Don't spend it yet. Mark explains why.

**🏛️ HE'S BEING OUTSPENT SEVEN TO ONE AND SAYS THE RACE IS TIED

** Haaland won her primary decisively and has significantly outraised Gregg so far. Mark pointed out that if this race stays competitive, it’s likely Gregg will face attacks from the other side. During the interview, Mark asked how Gregg plans to respond if and when that happens. Gregg laid out his strategy. Take a listen.
**🔥 WE ASKED HIM THE ABORTION QUESTION EVERYBODY EMAILS US ABOUT

** Can a governor end abortion in New Mexico? Krysty asked it flat out. His answer is honest, and plenty of people may not like it.

It also tells you exactly where to aim if you want this changed.

Peter,

**NEW YORK CITY HAS FALLEN, DAY OF MAMDANI!!**

We are in a political race for results now. I hope the Republican Party and MAGA movement can hear me on this. The stewards of capitalism must find a financial remedy to our current situation, through innovation and a commitment to sacred honor, before the nihilism and cynicism of Socialism take root. The "free market" and "free trade" must be modified for the times.

**THIS IS THE RED ALERT!** Mamdani is only the beginning. We must remain the party and movement of the working class.

| [ **FIGHT BACK AGAINST COMMUNISM** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=8c917eb8911b4df08061b84a79f18c72&_e=6oKzij6CQxuN5XW-hxfC8afUHXR5sMdpzMzMBjF8hhCLQhBxhDFYpvgF9QU6A0qtLXyCvj-5cppcqeGFxHdvvAhg5qjDkImMNGsZlVopLC6EtawJLSeBwxOJnBZ_5egbd1nFoijY9S5rwZmo0BENYhNmW4yf-PYnXxWEH9vO5dvvn5-GEQpKmIlG0qI3bPSjDvcOZwPeOwNTDDGJqGz7AcLZh9-HrnPqcTQkax3W7kYxaqVnZXnJSfGYlI3NfQ06S74agKKf-pG0jIUtdCeoAo-dgIiGWLV03Rh1dfOqQjsecPZEmamHVsPLe7adNie0Nu4Xmsdoq74m07sO7cSxJFW3O02MKh8jHYxhaZ9QGmUyo7yrOvxId63jD0Z58V4epaahONqVm6AhqJitvXKwDYzPNFb4fMzkrHNH1hruJ1lpGFKNVqAI5tAqL3MBuaBOXoks97l_x2B2NgL0Tgfuvhjt6oR1iPtOZy7sXozoJrph0yclaLlcfF3JagsuZPh3mVKB5zoleeuVboVYbY_ZECG4rBAJbpuBd0jOGPlSc9i4U2Ta9MmZfXjG2ajFeDTK)
---

We need to deregulate, reduce taxes on the working class, and, most importantly, enforce our antitrust laws. The monopolization in America is out of control, and the monopolization of finance is abhorrent. The problem is that politicians can't say that and hope to win because the control of money controls our elections, most of the time. At this point, if we try to hold onto this way, we will have to do it by force, and inevitably, that will become destabilizing itself.

What has staved off communism in America, in the past, was the cultural belief in socioeconomic mobility. The social piece is all but blown as everyone believes they're the star in their own movie now. Everybody believes they're more important than they actually are. Which has created an inverse epidemic of self-doubt and self-hatred. The economic mobility piece must be restored. But artificial intelligence and socialism won't do it. People have to be motivated and incentivized to get better, at a craft, a passion, a job, a skill...

_If those things become invaluable, we will have an even bigger existential crisis. Who are we even as humankind?_

Still, we cannot continue to pretend like the game hasn't been rigged. It disappoints me that more Republicans don't listen to Steve Bannon when he says we have to find a way to spread this wealth around... Yes, we detest communists because we can see when and where they have waved their flag in history, genocide follows.

**The uncomfortable truth about America is at our core, we have already become a communist nation.** When we print money, bail out the failures of the rich, and socialize the risk, we have undermined capitalism and meritocracy. If your society is built on money and you socialize the money, you're a communist nation. We have to turn back now. This has to become the beating heart of the MAGA movement. We must hold the principle and move people toward the principle.

**Convenience will be the death of freedom.** If you trade your freedom for security, you deserve neither, and you will have neither. This is true for the security of basic necessities or food and welfare, as well as the security of a military-industrial complex and dollar empire.

_**THIS IS WHY THEY FEAR ME, on both sides of the aisle.**_

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. subject: They stalled. They shut doors. Then Trump made it his #1 priority.

body:
Here's the part nobody in Washington is talking about. |
---
Patriot, For months, Senate leadership stalled, slow-walked, and shut doors in our faces on the **SAVE America Act**. We didn't stop. We flooded them with calls, emails, and activists. And now? **President Trump just made the SAVE America Act his number one priority** — calling for it to be attached to the one bill Congress absolutely must pass. Voter ID. Proof of citizenship to register. On the verge of becoming the law of the land. Even Elon weighed in after what we all watched happen in California: _"This is the only way to save democracy in America."_ But here's the part nobody in Washington is talking about — and the reason I'm not celebrating. Whether the SAVE America Act becomes law or not, the midterms are going to be a pure turnout war. So I'm not throwing a party. **I'm hiring.** My team at Early Vote Action is on the ground right now registering new Republican voters and building the most aggressive ballot-chasing and get-out-the-vote operation in our history. It's the exact playbook that flipped Pennsylvania for President Trump in 2024 — one voter at a time, at gun shows, truck stops, farmers markets, and front doors. President Trump did his part. The grassroots pressure is working. Now the midterms are on us. If we pair the SAVE America Act with a midterm landslide, we don't just win an election — we lock in a generation of victories.

body:
How we fight back against the pink haired activist librarians| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
| | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8aa7074c083946469d5014f2c5e38dad&_e=wSmWS3JSwWiR-JYAge5tQHE6oFR5it5jom-aEVc8fP6Dgnkae1IwGkbq7nGBM3fByoj4mmsCEw-m3BxZ7GlEFt5jmyE7M6wXkwKwm7soyQyAyf9BSA_sYOvniGN-V73u5di-cfWDifVoJ6APGIu9hWXVj9yqiJffKQWnudbj0kmcQqSnuHt14xEuKAvr8AT1XK-cyBZ6HX0V3fWMIioVWSFOvFimNjb4z3rMTZriK861qrdjiDxztQ0UHjuoz8r2tCxYJlwceTBhv3Yra9lokKrO1pYzV0KRAZfHO9w-v40RrkXAPU5kgAKX_GqHcrPorQPD1vAkkAyAD6bCsPQ6XlznpC_L3hf2ruvTmWaPuwp2KR_BUOV8zae2C0uQ0sj4sBHLx6m0oOObun7T29XRopU_ZitdNgfpa524eclJtbomR99PNK5jXHPDwjQ969sjAM3hqU3w7a-HujTrn_bFco_pIG6ZHLWKJtU987oTHhJtkt6Z0V2EVEMasCVFwSkrn-_2NrNNVjn1SBPH8ppVT9Yzd4s1bQ1pdKoHEAUFvivz_vsQqt37oFm1fPWT5RBSwhS-bu9caGUa2HF-0msy8URGLWb_Np3nUIq-cKGbOkUDVQnL1UG77lgOSEGCjSJuGNo1WlG0LYKthD-2nRdAsKLnBu2Lm2sMUwnGdHQA2KRNGHkrLSGOV62WOwPtg5ZTD-g8-EnlZ8xsYlaoi3o3fA%3D%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries.We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $125, or anything higher or lower please send in your sponsorship gift in the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.” Thank you!
